newsitem.title: SWEDEN: TENNIS-EDBERG PLAYS PIOLINE IN OPENING DAVIS CUP MATCH.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-EDBERG PLAYS PIOLINE IN OPENING DAVIS CUP MATCH.

text.p: Sweden's Stefan Edberg was drawn on Thursday to meet Cedric Pioline of France in the opening singles of the Davis Cup final on Friday.
The draw was as follows (Swedish names first):
Friday's singles (matches start at 1330 GMT) Stefan Edberg v Cedric Pioline Thomas Enqvist v Arnaud Boetsch
Saturday's doubles (starts 1500 GMT) Nicklas Kulti/Jonas Bjorkman v Guy Forget/Guillaume Raoux
Sunday's singles (start 1200 GMT) Enqvist v Pioline Edberg v Boetsch
